standing_rules: Nothing sent, posted, published, signed, or paid without Black's explicit approval of exact content.
No payments without explicit approval; no invented credentials; no spam or stream inflation.
Trust-verdict: never invent a score; insufficient-data is honest.
Needle Drop: a curator's promise is a claim, never a verification.
Crown motif exclusive to KingCode; CWI logo on all visuals.
